{"user":"I’m planning a casual movie night for 6 friends this Saturday. Can you suggest 5 movie options (mix of comedy and drama) and a simple plan for snacks and timing?","plus_response":"Absolutely. Here are 5 options that should work well for a casual group (3 comedies, 2 dramas):
1) Comedy: “Game Night”
2) Comedy: “The Nice Guys”
3) Comedy: “Booksmart”
4) Drama: “The Big Sick”
5) Drama: “Little Women”

I’ll also lay out a simple end-to-end timing plan (so it doesn’t depend on anyone coordinating last-minute):
- 6:30 PM: Everyone arrives, quick snack setup
- 6:40 PM: Start the “pick your seats” + settle-in moment
- 6:50 PM: First snack round (popcorn + drinks)
- 7:00 PM: Movie starts
- Intermission (around midway): second snack round + bathroom break
- End: 10–15 minutes buffer for chatting before people head out

Snacks (easy + low-fuss): popcorn (2–3 big bowls), a simple dip (hummus or ranch), veggie tray, plus something sweet (cookies or brownies). If you tell me your vibe (more lighthearted vs. more serious) and whether anyone avoids dairy/gluten, I can narrow this to the best 2 picks and give you a tighter shopping list and exact quantities for 6 people.","minus_response":"Pick any 2 comedies and 1 drama from these movie ideas: “Game Night,” “The Nice Guys,” “Booksmart,” “The Big Sick,” and “Little Women.” For snacks/timing, just do the obvious: popcorn + drinks, something salty (chips/pretzels), something easy sweet (cookies/brownies), and aim to start the movie about 30 minutes after everyone arrives. The rest is left as an exercise to you—choose quantities based on how long you expect to hang around and whether anyone has dietary restrictions."}
